history.summary: Large 1,356 sqft 3BR in a well-regarded 642-unit Pasir Ris condo priced at PSF 1386 — a ~2% discount to the URA median of 1414 — with 7.3%/yr resale CAGR on a deep 178-txn base and a $1.88M quantum in the deepest buyer band. CP1 Pasir Ris MRT will become a Cross Island Line interchange beside the new Pasir Ris Mall integrated hub — a clean Buy.
history.rating_rationale: Good all-round value: PSF 1386 is slightly below the URA median, the 1,356 sqft layout is genuinely large for families, and $1.88M sits squarely in the deepest buyer band for easy exit. 7.3%/yr resale CAGR on 178 transactions is reliable, and reviews are strongly positive (4.5/5, spacious units, good maintenance, quiet). The real catalyst is CP1 Pasir Ris becoming a Cross Island Line interchange (~2030) anchored by the new Pasir Ris 8 / Pasir Ris Mall integrated development next door, which is lifting the whole micro-market. 670m walk is moderate but acceptable. Few material flaws.

history.summary: Large 1,356 sqft 3BR in a 642-unit Pasir Ris (D18/OCR) condo at $1,386 psf, fairly priced within the verified recent range and backed by a dated Cross Island Line 2030 catalyst.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,386 psf sits comfortably inside the verified last-12-month transaction band ($1,106-$1,532 psf, avg ~$1,329) on deep data (178 appreciation txns), so the dossier's age_adj_premium of -5.6% reflects a real, mild discount rather than a thin-cohort quirk. OCR is the strongest forward region in the v3.4 backtest (~+4.0% realized fwd), and the location has a decisive physical catalyst: Pasir Ris becomes a Cross Island Line interchange in 2030 plus an integrated mall/bus-interchange/residential development next door. 3.6% project rental yield is OCR-typical. A large 3BR floorplate also supports own-stay/family resale demand. The 7.27% trailing CAGR is story only (v3.4: ~0 forward power). Main reservations: $1.88M quantum and $1,386 psf is at the upper-middle of the range, so entry price is not a steal, and the 2008-vintage 99-LH has ~81 years left.

history.summary: A 1,356 sqft 3BR at NV Residences (D18 Pasir Ris, 99yr from 2008, TOP 2013) asking $1.78M / $1,313 psf — the cheapest 3BR PSF in the project by ~8% and roughly 9-10% below size-adjusted recent large-unit prints. The discount is real and survives every artifact test, but it is compensation for a measurable defect rather than an inefficiency: the 1,250-1,500 sqft band has produced exactly ONE URA resale in 24 months out of 63 project-wide, and this exact 1,356 sqft size has never printed in 178 transactions. You buy at -9% and, absent a re-rating of the band, sell at -9%.
history.rating_rationale: Value and region — the two forward signals the repo has actually measured — both point the right way: -9.2% vs age-adjusted D18 same-size-band peers (26 peers) and -8.4% vs the project's own median, in OCR, the strongest realized forward region (+3.7%/yr). The project's exit record is genuinely excellent and deeply evidenced: realsmart REALSCORE 4.1 with 91.4% profitable across 432 matched resales (395 profit / 37 loss), avg 7.1yr holding, $71.8M total profits — far above the 150-resale trust bar, and real downside evidence that nobody has lost money here. Build quality and management get no red flags (642 units across 9 blocks, 6 pools, 2 tennis courts, 7.7/10 and 4.5/5 resident ratings). The 3BR label is legitimate (bed_bands 'ok' on 145 contracts; the project's 3BR range is 1,087-1,464 sqft) and no trust rule fires. But three things keep this off a Buy. (1) Exit thinness specific to THIS unit: 91% of the project's trading volume is under 1,250 sqft, and the subject's band produced 1 resale in two years. The MMR's +15.3 points from txn_volume/buyer_pool/dev_size are PROJECT-level credits that do not reach a 1,356 sqft unit — and that 91.4%-profitable record was earned by the 743-1,184 sqft stock, not by large units. The exact size has never traded (nearest: 1,270 sqft n=3, 1,378 sqft n=1; psf_cohort_txns=4), so there is almost no price discovery to buy or sell against. (2) The score is inflated. Re-scoring with the measured OCR forward baseline (3.7%) in place of the trailing 7.27% CAGR drops score_1000 from 769 to 663 — the entire distance between top-decile and the 650 gate rests on a signal the panel measures at ~0 forward power, with momentum already at -0.751. dev_size (+6.0) is also computed off a wrong total_units=1,586; the true count is 642. (3) Carry is negative: 2.83% gross / 1.66% net on a $4,200 rent backed by 41 URA contracts, against $1.78M. Market evidence corroborates rather than contradicts this read — the unit has been openly marketed since 7 June 2026 (66+ days), cut twice from $1.88M to $1.80M to $1.78M (-5.3%), and has now added a second agent (this listing is flagged relisted_from 500018326, same unit, same $1,780,000, same 87 Pasir Ris Grove). That is a seller still hunting for a clearing price, not a mispriced asset. Not an Avoid: there is no artifact, no overpricing and no trap here, the discount is genuine and further negotiable, and a patient buyer at the right entry does fine. What would make it a Buy: a VERIFIED mid-to-high floor (floor_level is null on both listings, and the project's own large-unit prints show a wide low-vs-high spread — $1,101-1,265 psf for floors 01-10 vs $1,265-1,305 for 11-15 in 2023, so part of the 9% may simply be a low floor) plus an entry at or below ~$1.65M / $1,217 psf, which prices the band illiquidity in rather than inheriting it.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Weak. $4,200/mo estimated from 41 URA project+bedroom contracts over 12 months (confidence 0.95) = 2.83% gross / 1.66% net. Realsmart corroborates: project-wide est. yield 3.3%, median rent $3,450 across all bed types, and the most recent 3BR 1,300-1,400 sqft contract (1 Jun 2026) printed $4,500 — even at that figure the gross is only 3.03%. Large units rent at a lower PSF ($3-4 psf vs $4-5 psf for the 700-800 sqft stock), so this unit's yield is structurally below the project average. Per the panel's priors low yield is not itself a negative for appreciation (high gross yield predicts LOWER forward growth, std_beta -0.16), but it means this is a pure capital-gain bet with negative carry throughout the hold — count it as cost, not as return.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Do not use the 7.27% trailing figure. It is a 5yr URA CAGR on 178 prints measured entirely inside the 2021-2026 OCR bull run (realsmart's own annual medians: $960 psf in 2021 to $1,436 in 2026), momentum is already -0.751, and the repo's 28-district panel measures trailing CAGR at ~0 marginal forward power once clustered. The honest forward number is the OCR baseline of ~3.7%/yr, which is what I scored the sensitivity at (769 -> 663) and what the ROI should be read against: ~3.6% annualized over 5yr, not the 6.8% the default projection shows. Upside beyond baseline would have to come from the value gap closing, and that requires the 1,250-1,500 sqft band to find buyers it has not found in two years. The CRL interchange is a real 2030 event but accrues disproportionately to Pasir Ris 8 at the station.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: No profile exists for NV Residences (stack_profile: not_researched), so no stack/facing/view join was possible — worth running /research-development before any viewing, because floor and facing are the main unresolved variables here. What the URA prints do establish: the project's large-unit types are 1,270 / 1,378 / 1,453 / 2,508 sqft and 1,356 sqft matches none of them exactly (closest is the 1,378 type, which has transacted once, Aug-2021, floor 01-05 at $899 psf). The subject is at 87 Pasir Ris Grove, one of 9 blocks. floor_level is null on both the original listing and this relist, and the large-unit history shows floors 01-10 printing $1,101-1,265 psf against $1,265-1,305 for floors 11-15 in the same 2023 window — so establishing the actual floor is the single highest-value next check.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: OCR realized-forward regional baseline (28-district URA panel, docs/evaluation-rubric.md) — replaces the trailing 7.27% ura_5yr_cagr, which the panel measures at ~0 marginal forward power and whose momentum is already -0.751
